report_note: Subagent report-file guard refused REPORT.md; orchestrator reconstructed it. 8 harnesses on disk.

findings.title: Battery view publishes buffer/DHW stores at ThermalState constructor defaults on plants that do not model them
findings.claim: battery.build() guards the optional buffer/DHW stores with `state.<field> is not None` on non-Optional floats defaulting to 40.0/55.0 C that no code path ever sets to None, so both guards are invariant: a 35 L buffer the plant's own describe_setup() reports as is_store=false is listed as a storage component, and the default-on BATTERY/ENERGY_STORAGE aggregate includes heat at a temperature nothing measured.
findings.mechanism: battery.py:333 (buffer) and :320 (DHW) guard on `is not None` against thermal_model.py:1080/1085 non-Optional floats defaulting 40.0/55.0; the only live-state write is coordinator.py:5284 inside `if buffer_reading.ok`, the only other assignment is dataclasses.replace at thermal_model.py:2318. Contrast the wood tank (thermal_model.py:1109 made Optional) where the sentinel is reachable.

perturbation.change: make buffer_is_store true (volume 750.0, manual mixing valve) on every cell; separately map both probes (buffer 45.0 C, DHW 52.0 C)

findings.metric_definition: cells (of 8) whose published battery components list buffer_tank while the same plant's describe_setup()['buffer']['is_store'] is false

null_control.note: both tallies reproduce exactly on a second pass

findings.proposed_fix_scope: report-only surface: make ThermalState.buffer_tank_temperature/dhw_temperature Optional, or gate components on params.buffer_is_store and reading_ok; and/or extend _MeasuredStoreMixin.available. Golden-bearing: 5 tests/golden/coord_*.json pin data.battery; a fixer owes the claim-file process.
